data_fields.name: pile_despawn
data_fields.donor_constant: duration passed by script (no engine default)

best_idea: Give a dropped pile to its killer for a fixed window (100 ticks in the donor), then make it public; an untradeable pile never goes public and simply expires.
decision_why: Owner-first window, untradeable rule and despawn timer fit a server-verified ground pile; window, timer and cap become zone data, and the owner check runs in the server take handler in the one ledger.
acceptance: A server test drops a pile for player A; a take by B inside the window is refused, A's take succeeds, and after the window any player can take it; an untradeable pile never becomes public and is removed at its despawn tick.
